definitions.explanation: One of the pair of organs in the body that filters blood and produces urine. Commonly encountered in medical, health, and dietary contexts.

examples.japanese: {腎臓|じんぞう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{低下|ていか}→低下：04065_teika⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{塩分|えんぶん}→塩分：09945_enbun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧すぎ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腎臓|じんぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧。
examples.english: Consuming too much salt puts strain on the kidneys.

examples.japanese: ⟦{父|ちち}→父：00566_chichi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{腎臓|じんぞう}⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{受|う}けて→受ける：01215_ukeru⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}した→回復する：21330_kaifukusuru⟧。
examples.english: My father recovered after receiving a kidney transplant.

notes:
USAGE:
Note the homophone ⟦{人造|じんぞう}→人造：04284_jinzou⟧ (artificial, man-made) — context usually makes the distinction clear.

In Japanese, {腎臓|じんぞう} follows the pattern of other internal organ names: ⟦{心臓|しんぞう}→心臓：03262_shinzou⟧ (heart), ⟦{肝臓|かんぞう}→肝臓：05029_kanzou⟧ (liver), ⟦{脾臓|ひぞう}→脾臓：05961_hizou⟧ (spleen). The {臓|ぞう} character means "internal organ."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腎臓|じんぞう}⟦{移植|いしょく}→移植：13761_ishoku⟧: kidney transplant
- {腎臓|じんぞう}{結石|けっせき}: kidney stone
- {腎臓|じんぞう}{病|びょう}: kidney disease
- ⟦{人工|じんこう}→人工：11573_jinkou⟧⟦{透析|とうせき}→透析：27901_touseki⟧: dialysis (for kidney failure)
- {腎臓|じんぞう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{負担|ふたん}→負担：09752_futan⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧: to strain the kidneys
